control_implications.evidence_excerpt: Broadcom has shipped patches to address 23 vulnerabilities impacting VMware ESX, vCenter, Workstation, Fusion, and Avi Load Balancer, including one critical bug that could be abused to bypass authentication. control_implications.headline: VMware vCenter exposes authentication bypass
control_implications.significance: This critical authentication bypass in VMware vCenter weakens access controls for virtualized infrastructure. Vulnerability owners should confirm affected versions are identified and patches applied or compensating controls validated.

control_implications.evidence_excerpt: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Monday added two flaws impacting N-able MailAssure and MONAI Label to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, citing evidence of active exploitation. control_implications.headline: N-able MailAssure appears in CISA exploited catalog
control_implications.significance: Active exploitation of N-able MailAssure SSRF vulnerability demands immediate asset identification. Vulnerability owners should verify whether MailAssure instances exist in the environment and confirm remediation status.

control_implications.headline: Check Point Security Management servers targeted by AI campaign
control_implications.significance: AI-driven targeting of security management infrastructure challenges detection assumptions. Monitoring owners should review telemetry coverage for Check Point management interfaces and validate alert routing for anomalous administrative activity.

control_implications.evidence_excerpt: Palo Alto Networks Unit 42 has disclosed that it's tracking and has responded to "numerous waves of vishing attacks" orchestrated by Com-affiliated threat actors since August 2026 that have led to data theft and extortion attempts. The attacks have targeted financial services, healthcare, and legal services located in the U.S., the U.K., and Australia.
control_implications.headline: Cloud accounts hijacked via vishing campaigns
control_implications.significance: Vishing campaigns bypassing authentication to hijack cloud accounts expose gaps in identity verification. Access management owners should confirm multi-factor authentication coverage for cloud administrative access and review session revocation procedures.

control_implications.evidence_excerpt: WordPress has removed six WordPress plugins developed by WP Connect after they were backdoored on November 22, 2026, to enable arbitrary code execution on sites that have them installed, following a suspected compromise of the developer's account. The WordPress plugins team has independently detected and blocked the threat before it could be officially released.
control_implications.headline: WP Connect plugins backdoored in supply chain compromise
control_implications.significance: Supply chain compromise of WordPress plugins introduces arbitrary code execution risk. Third-party risk owners should inventory WP Connect plugin usage and verify removal or mitigation with application owners.

control_implications.evidence_excerpt: Rackspace is shutting down its Rackspace Spot cloud platform after a security breach allowed hackers to access customer Kubernetes clusters and secrets, giving customers until December 8 to migrate their services and download their data
control_implications.headline: Rackspace Spot cloud platform shut down after breach
control_implications.significance: Cloud provider breach exposing Kubernetes clusters and secrets forces customer migration. Third-party risk owners should assess dependency on Rackspace Spot, confirm data retrieval, and evaluate alternative provider assurances.

paragraphs.text: Critical authentication bypass in VMware vCenter and active exploitation of N-able MailAssure and Check Point management servers demand immediate vulnerability management attention. Broadcom has released patches for 23 VMware vulnerabilities including a 9.8-rated auth bypass, while CISA added MailAssure SSRF to its exploited catalog. An AI-driven campaign compromised 24 Check Point management servers across financial services, energy, and government sectors. Vulnerability and monitoring owners should prioritize asset identification, patch validation, and detection coverage for security management interfaces.

Vishing campaigns hijacking cloud accounts, backdoored WordPress plugins, and the Rackspace Spot platform shutdown reveal expanding identity and supply chain exposures. Com-affiliated actors have conducted vishing against financial services, healthcare, and legal sectors since August 2026. WordPress removed six WP Connect plugins backdoored for arbitrary code execution. Rackspace customers must migrate from Spot by December 8 after Kubernetes cluster and secrets access. Access management and third-party risk owners should verify cloud authentication controls, inventory affected plugins, and assess provider dependencies.
